description: Optimized Kerrigan default repo-protection shape, built for swarm repos running many concurrent cloud PRs (velocity + scale + green-main quality). Copy this file to .github/repo-protection.json in a target repo to adopt it, then override any field for that repo's setup (e.g. drop the merge queue for a low-volume repo, or change required_checks to match its CI job names). The apply tool uses one branch ruleset for required checks + merge queue, then clears classic required_status_checks to avoid conflicts. With the file present: tools/validators/check_merge_queue.py enforces the 'every required check runs on merge_group' invariant, and tools/configure-repo-protection.ps1 applies the settings to the repo (dry-run by default).
